sections.label: Prepare q0
sections.description: Start with one excitation at the top of the ring.

sections.label: Split the paths
sections.description: The two CNOTs and the Hadamard split the excitation between q0 and q1. Each now has a 50% chance of reading 1.

sections.label: Follow both arms
sections.description: Each pair of SWAPs moves the two amplitudes one site. Follow q0 through q7 to q5 and q1 through q2 to q4.

sections.label: Change one phase
sections.description: Z on q4 reverses the sign of that path's amplitude. Both paths still have equal probability.

sections.label: Recombine at q4 and q5
sections.description: Interference sends the excitation to q4. Delete the Z in step 8 and run again to send it to q5.
